title: Backup attachment for source Pager notifications

scope.rationale: attachBackupObject publishes a partially completed backup for source-page update and Pager-reset notifications. The bounded typed owner models list membership explicitly and attaches only after a step leaves pages remaining.
excluded_responsibilities: Per-page source update and complete restart bodies

external_source_responsibilities: Backup step determines that copy progress is partial
Source update/restart owners consume attached backup state
Finish unlinks an attached source owner
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source attachment body is assigned. The typed step owner invokes it only after publishing remaining progress.

inputs: Mutable live Backup not already attached, under source owner synchronization
outputs: Backup marked attached for source notification ownership
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Backup; source owns notification-list membership after publication.
contracts.state_and_results: Precondition requires detached state. Successful publication sets attached exactly once; the source linked-list pointer topology is abstracted by typed membership.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No direct I/O or callback. Source Btree synchronization is a caller precondition.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible for valid detached owner. Attached state remains active until finish.

representation_differences: Source pNext/Pager head insertion is represented by Backup.attached because the bounded owner currently permits one typed callback target rather than exposing intrusive pointers.
The source Btree mutex assertion is represented by the caller-owned typed state-machine boundary plus a detached-state assertion.

oracle.protocol: Initialize a backup, require detached state, attach it, require attached state, restore the synthetic trace to detached, and execute complete step ownership. Partial-step production callers invoke the same helper.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact boolean membership and typed step behavior.

assurance.malformed_input: Typed non-null owner; duplicate attachment violates assertion/precondition.
assurance.continuation: Attached partial backup remains reusable for subsequent step/update/restart.

integration.native_call_path: step invokes attachBackupObject when next_page remains within the source page count.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Direct Backup.attached assignment in step is retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires typed list/unlink ownership or public Backup integration, pinned-C attachment trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Represent or connect source notification-list unlink in finish.
Connect the internal source-shaped backup state machine to the public Backup owner.
